scenarios.prompt: A hub has several parallel quests and one tracked primary objective. Define stable node IDs, dependencies and graph states independently from UI pins.

criteria.identity: Quest nodes use stable IDs and authored dependencies.
criteria.parallelism: Graph state may contain multiple active hooks independent from UI tracking.
criteria.evidence: Branch, convergence, ordering and prerequisite states are explainable.
